'''Tion''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]]. 

== Appearance ==
She has gray eyes and is very tall and wide.

== Activities ==
She participated in the murder of [[Desaine]] and fights in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. She was "Chosen from the strongest of the Shaido Wise Ones who could wield the One Power". She helps to activate the call box and is present when both Cadder ([[Sammael]]) and Maisia ([[Graendal]]) arrive.

She ends up Traveling to [[Ghealdan]]. With [[Therava]] and a few other Wise Ones she stands up to [[Sevanna]] and begins to take away some of her power.
